snippet.title: BEGHOST - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3957810/Beghost/

BEGHOST is a narrative-heavy 2D action-adventure game set in the bowels of a haunted dungeon. Uncover the dungeon's darkest secrets alongside your companion Bee as you navigate your way through enemies, traps, and more in a desperate attempt to escape!

Special thanks to @Joykons for the animation near the end!

Please check out my other works!
https://vidboy.net
